name: binding_paired_sem_v3
notes: Whole-pipeline binding diversity (correction 2026-09-25 item 2): paired scenes (identical initial scene, every cube assigned as patient in turn, role-independent slot order), each with its own scripted_teacher demonstration -> realizer/encoder/probes trained on binding-varying FACTUAL data; plus binding_cf 0.5 same-trajectory/different-meaning copies (probe+KL only, no realizer loss); goal_effect probe (item 5). 20k steps (v1 realize loss plateaus by ~15k). sem/nosem differ only in semantic_weight. Training pack also includes the dual-arm manipulator-assignment pairs (assign_pick_place_v1, source_train, 5 invalid DART episodes excluded).
